decisions.title: Approve package v4.1.5 (existing request, not created here)
decisions.status: open (pending; FREEZE step 2 is PR #143, step 3 records it)
decisions.conflictingEvidence: v4.1.5 is a CANDIDATE: no tag indy-init-requirements-v4.1.5; kickoff/rehearsal-007/approvals.causa.json holds ODR-V415-01/-03/-04/-IF-VIEW but not ODR-V415-02.
alternatives: A: approve and tag v4.1.5 (FREEZE.md steps 3-4)
B: fall back to v4.1.4 per ODR-V415-04
decisions.recommendation: A. This package's historical replay shows v4.1.5 represents 1,363/1,363 catalog events losslessly; v4.1.4 represents 0 (envelope provenance) and lacks a case for 487.
decisions.compatibilityImpact: None on data. B leaves 487 historical events without a case.

decisions.title: Adopt the causa-storage 1.1.0 additive extension and a v4.1.6 successor that carries it
decisions.conflictingEvidence: ODR-R10-26 A (recorded) commissions causa-data storage v1.1 for these fields; causa-data at e8259df has only contract/v1.0.0. v4.1.5 has the ConclusionRecorded event but no RecordConclusion command. Without both, 14 of 45 UI bindings have no defined write path (CONTRACT-READINESS.json).
alternatives: A: release causa-storage 1.1.0 exactly as DOMAIN-CONTRACT.json proposedStorageExtension (6 new events, 2 new relationship kinds; no v1.0.0 change) and compile v4.1.6 = v4.1.5 + those CoreEvent cases + 7 CoreCommand cases (ReviseInvestigationDetails, ReviseObservation, ReviseHypothesis, ReviseEvidence, ReviseEvidenceRelationship, WithdrawEvidenceRelationship, RecordConclusion)
B: as A but only RecordConclusion now (no storage change), the rest after the competition; mark the 13 affected journeys as declared expected failures
C: amend the catalog to the v1.0.0 vocabulary (drop INV-023/025/027/029/034 and the two kinds)
decisions.recommendation: A. Every proposed event is additive (§13.1): v1.0.0 histories read unchanged (CR-HIST-* stays green) and a v1.0.0 reader refuses the new data. B is the fallback if the freeze cycle cannot finish before kickoff.
decisions.compatibilityImpact: Additive minor version; no migration; historical cases gain nothing (OD-HC-06 B: nothing is fabricated).
decisions.deferralConsequence: The competition builds against v4.1.5: journeys J1-03, J2-01, J2-03, J2-04, J2-05, J2-06, J2-07, J2-09 cannot round-trip the affected fields, and agents must not invent storage for them.

decisions.title: Evidence category on write
decisions.conflictingEvidence: EvidenceAdmitted.category is a required closed enum (directObservation, measurement, log, document, experimentResult, testimony, externalReference); CAT-CAUSA-INVESTIGATION has no field for it, so AdmitEvidence has no input path.
alternatives: A: add a required catalog field INV-045 'Evidence category' (select over the seven wire values)
B: a fixed category for UI-entered evidence (which one is a business rule only the owner can set)
C: make category nullable in causa-storage 1.1.0 for new evidence
decisions.recommendation: A. It invents no meaning and the wire already defines the closed set.
decisions.compatibilityImpact: A and B: none. C: a new event shape.
decisions.deferralConsequence: No evidence can be admitted from the UI without an agent choosing a category.

decisions.title: Evidence source reference: optional in the catalog, required on the wire
decisions.conflictingEvidence: INV-028 required:false; EvidenceAdmitted.source is required non-blank text (R3.2 provenance). FIELD-MAPPING.md: 'Provenance: where it came from'.
alternatives: A: make INV-028 required (catalog amendment)
B: causa-storage 1.1.0 nullable source for UI-admitted evidence
C: the UI writes a fixed placeholder (fabricates provenance; not recommended)
decisions.recommendation: A. R3.2 already requires provenance for evidence.
decisions.deferralConsequence: Evidence without a source is refused by the codec (CAUSA.SCHEMA_VIOLATION).

decisions.title: Conclusion strength on write
decisions.conflictingEvidence: ConclusionRecorded.strength is a required enum (plausibleExplanation, leadingExplanation, supportedCause, confirmedCause, acceptedWithResidualUncertainty); INV-032/033 give only a statement. INVESTIGATION-SEMANTICS.md: 'conclusion strength and residual uncertainty are visible together'.
alternatives: A: add a required catalog field INV-046 'Conclusion strength' (radio group over the five values)
B: a fixed strength for UI conclusions (owner picks which)
decisions.deferralConsequence: No conclusion can be recorded without an agent choosing a strength.

decisions.title: INV-011 'Hypothesis explanation' maps to HypothesisRecorded.mechanism
decisions.conflictingEvidence: S04 'what it explains' vs the wire's mechanism ('Proposed mechanism, if stated', FIELD-MAPPING.md). No other wire field can hold it.
alternatives: A: confirm the mapping explanation = mechanism
B: a separate explanation field in causa-storage 1.1.0
decisions.recommendation: A. mechanism is nullable, matching CF-03 A (optional on record).
decisions.deferralConsequence: Agents must guess what the field means.

decisions.title: INV-035 for evidence: which parts are editable with the same id
decisions.conflictingEvidence: INV-035 says an edited evidence item keeps its identifier; causa-storage v1.0.0 corrects evidence only by EvidenceSuperseded to a new id; R3 and CONTRACT §5.5 keep admitted content immutable.
alternatives: A: label, source and URL are revisable with the same id (EvidenceRevised); content changes only by supersession (new id, relationships stay on the old item until reassessed)
B: content also revisable in place with the same id
decisions.recommendation: A. It keeps evidence (the admitted original) distinct from its description and from interpretations.
decisions.compatibilityImpact: A: as proposed. B: breaks the immutability of admitted content.
decisions.deferralConsequence: J2-06/J2-09 evidence edits have no defined meaning.

decisions.title: Adopt this contract package and its validator as owner-controlled verification assets
decisions.conflictingEvidence: OD-INDY-22 forbids a rehearsal to copy code from earlier work; OD-HC-05 B chose route R2 (freeze checks as owner-controlled verification assets that the rehearsal runs from the governed checkout). This package is agent-authored and not frozen, and no Conditor, Praxis, Dokimos or Ordo step runs it today.
alternatives: A: freeze the package (tag) as a governed verification asset, run from SRC like verification/ (route R2), and add `contract-readiness check --require-pass` to the T0 preflight
B: reference only; competition agents read it but nothing enforces it
C: fold the registries into the v4.1.6 successor package
decisions.recommendation: A, with C for the parts OD-CR-01 compiles into v4.1.6.
decisions.deferralConsequence: Competition agents may consume it, but it has no governed status and its gate is advisory.

decisions.title: Actor identity for UI writes
decisions.conflictingEvidence: actorId must be stable, non-secret and non-personal (CONTRACT §5.3); ActorContext = {ActorId: string} does not say where it comes from (DATA-REPOSITORY-CONTRACT.md S7). Rehearsal workspaces used 'live-test-operator'.
alternatives: A: a fixed configured id per deployment, kind human (for example 'causa-operator')
B: an opaque id derived from the GitHub account id (personal data; not recommended)
decisions.deferralConsequence: Each agent picks its own actor id; histories differ between runs.
